mutations.label: ADR-082 T3: a regressed run attests
mutations.only: ^an outside run whose own verdicts regressed does not attest a release$

mutations.label: ADR-082 T3: an uncompared run reads as nobody having run the readers
mutations.only: ^an attestation from 3.8.0 on must say what it compared$

mutations.label: ADR-082 T3: an attestation from before the field is held to it
mutations.only: ^an older attestation, or a run that only recovered verdicts, still attests$

mutations.label: ADR-082 T3: a regressed run's advice says git could not look
mutations.from: regressed: 'Do NOT tag this sha. An outside run reports adr-lint verdicts that left PASS against its own earlier report '
mutations.to: unregressed: 'Do NOT tag this sha. An outside run reports adr-lint verdicts that left PASS against its own earlier report '
mutations.only: ^the advice under an UNPROVEN outside run says which could-not-look it is$

mutations.label: review of ADR-082: a run that compared zero records attests
mutations.only: ^a regression is never hidden by the attestation version, and a run that compared nothing does not attest$

mutations.label: review of ADR-082: a regression under an odd version attests
mutations.only: ^a regression is never hidden by the attestation version, and a run that compared nothing does not attest$

mutations.label: review of ADR-082: an unchecked attestation beside an uncompared one is not named
mutations.only: ^a regression is never hidden by the attestation version, and a run that compared nothing does not attest$

mutations.label: release: a run with zero jobs is not nine green ones
mutations.to: return { verdict: 'success', reason: 'no jobs, nothing to object to', jobs: [] }
mutations.only: ^(?:an empty or unreadable answer is "could not look", never a pass)$

mutations.label: release: an unfinished job is not a concluded one
mutations.only: ^(?:a run still in flight is incomplete, which is not the same as failed|the verdicts are five distinct answers, not a boolean wearing five names)$

mutations.label: release: an unknown option is not silently taken for a sha
mutations.only: ^(?:an option is not a sha, and a bare dash-argument never reaches git rev-parse)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: a run raised by a push is not a full campaign
mutations.only: ^(?:a green run raised by a push is not release evidence, because its campaign may be cached \(BACKLOG §142\)|the verdicts are five distinct answers, not a boolean wearing five names)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: a run that does not say what raised it is could-not-look
mutations.only: ^(?:a green run raised by a push is not release evidence, because its campaign may be cached \(BACKLOG §142\))$

mutations.label: release-evidence: a createdAt tie is broken by the event, not by list order
mutations.only: ^(?:a dispatch and a push at the same instant resolve to the dispatch)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: only runs tied at the newest instant may prefer a dispatch
mutations.only: ^(?:a newer push still wins over an older dispatch)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: an ordering nothing can establish is refused, not guessed
mutations.only: ^(?:an ordering nothing can establish is refused, not guessed)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: the run list is scoped to the campaign workflow
mutations.only: ^(?:the run list is scoped to the campaign workflow, not to the sha alone)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: a short sha is expanded before gh is asked
mutations.only: ^(?:a short sha is EXPANDED before gh is asked, at the boundary that shells out)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: readers changed since the tag with no outside run attested is UNPROVEN, not cleared (§18)
mutations.only: ^(?:a release whose readers changed since the last tag needs an outside run attested after it|outsideRunEvidence anchors on the tag before the sha and refuses a run that did not see every reader change|an attestation git cannot check is coverage unknown, never coverage absent)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: an outside run counts only when it carries every reader change up to the sha
mutations.from: try { return git(['diff', '--name-only', `${at}..${sha}`, '--', ...READER_PATHS]) === '' } catch { return null }
mutations.to: try { return true } catch { return null }
mutations.only: ^(?:outsideRunEvidence anchors on the tag before the sha and refuses a run that did not see every reader change)$

mutations.label: release-evidence: an attestation git could not check is coverage unknown, never absent
mutations.only: ^(?:an attestation git cannot check is coverage unknown, never coverage absent)$

mutations.label: readers: release-evidence diffs the reader directories as repository paths
mutations.only: names every plugin directory

mutations.label: ADR-089 T3: a PARTIAL attestation attests a release alone (Alternative (d) dropped)
mutations.only: release-evidence attests a partial run only beside an ok one

mutations.label: ADR-089 T3: the attested reason drops what a run did not see
mutations.only: release-evidence names an unread part of an attested corpus

mutations.label: ADR-089 review: an UNPROVEN attestation is listed as attesting beside an ok one
mutations.only: release-evidence never lists an unproven run as attesting
